items.title: 68087_Cliff Leeman oral history interview
items.q: The other band across from us was Woody Herman, his first three weeks that he broke up with Isham Jones

ctx.x: Yes. A haphazard name for having a steppingstone, as Joe Haymes' orchestra was later on -- it was a steppingstone for good musicians. Anyway, on a Sunday afternoon, somebody said, 'Somebody here wants to talk to you' and we were at the Roseland doing a matinee, the old Roseland on Broadway. The other band across from us was Woody Herman, his first three weeks that he broke up with Isham Jones, and were forming a new orchestra. I was with Hank Biagmini Viagmini.
